summary_en: This Phase 2 study tests plixorafenib, a drug taken by mouth, in people with solid tumors or primary brain and spinal cord (CNS) tumors that have BRAF changes, including rare cancers such as anaplastic thyroid, ovarian, and cholangiocarcinoma. Plixorafenib is given as oral tablets continuously in 3-week cycles until disease progression, unacceptable toxicity, or another reason for withdrawal. The main outcome is not stated in the record; the study is Phase 2.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa plixorafenib, un medicamento que se toma por vía oral, en personas con tumores sólidos o tumores primarios del sistema nervioso central (SNC) que tienen alteraciones en BRAF, incluidos cánceres raros como el carcinoma anaplásico de tiroides, el cáncer de ovario y el colangiocarcinoma. Plixorafenib se administra en tabletas por vía oral de forma continua en ciclos de 3 semanas, hasta la progresión de la enfermedad, toxicidad inaceptable u otra razón para retirarse. El resultado principal no se indica en el registro; el estudio es de fase 2.
who_for: Age 8 years or older and weight 25 kg or more.
Tumor with a BRAF fusion or BRAF V600E mutation, as defined by the subprotocol.
Unresectable, locally advanced, or metastatic disease, or recurrent or progressive CNS tumor.
Prior standard therapy received, not tolerated, or judged not appropriate by the investigator.
Archival tumor tissue available, or a new biopsy where required, and consent to provide scans.
not_for: Prior treatment with BRAF, ERK, or MEK inhibitors (depends on subprotocol).
Known or suspected NF-1 or RAS-related gene alterations.
Malignancy with co-occurring activating RAS mutation (Subprotocol A).
Uncontrolled illness that would limit compliance, or HIV infection with exceptions.
